name: Menslage (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, red and white, charged below the centre with the municipal arms of Menslage (a dragon and a rose on red and white).
history: The arms, designed by Ulf-Dietrich Korn, were granted by the Landkreis Osnabrück in 1983; the banner is divided white and red with the arms.
